description: Starkregengefahrenkarte - Jüchen WMS is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.rhein-kreis-neuss.de. This service contains the heavy rain hazard maps of the city of Jüchen and shows the precipitation load of the city area for various heavy rain events, including a 30th and a 100th. Annual rain event. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Heavy rain hazard map - Jüchen WMS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Überflutung, Starkregen, Wasserhöhen, Jüchen, Wasser. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
